description: Ghost Ridge Supply Co. is a tactical, outdoor and lifestyle brand built for firearms enthusiasts, outdoorsmen and people who live the culture. We offer original apparel, hats, accessories, tactical and outdoor gear, limited-edition drops, mystery boxes and recurring Battle Box memberships. Ghost Ridge also produces entertaining, personality-driven media featuring firearms and gear reviews, industry discussions, product testing, outdoor adventures and collaborations with creators. A major part of the Ghost Ridge experience is our professionally administered sweepstakes, giving customers opportunities to win premium firearms, optics, gear, hunting and outdoor packages, and other high-value prizes, with free alternative methods of entry available as required by official rules. Our goal is bigger than selling products—we're building a nationwide community around quality gear, authentic entertainment, unforgettable experiences and the question: What crazy thing is Ghost Ridge doing next?

GHOST RIDGE SUPPLY CO. AFFILIATE PROGRAM

TERMS & CONDITIONS

Welcome to the Ghost Ridge Supply Co. Affiliate Program.

Ghost Ridge Supply Co. (“Ghost Ridge,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) is building more than an apparel company. We are a tactical, outdoor, and lifestyle brand built around quality products, original content, community, exclusive drops, gear, and promotional sweepstakes conducted pursuant to their applicable Official Rules.

Our Affiliate Program is designed to build long-term relationships with creators who genuinely fit the Ghost Ridge community while rewarding the people who help us grow.

By registering for or participating in the Ghost Ridge Affiliate Program (“Program”), you (“Affiliate”) agree to these Terms & Conditions.

If you do not agree to these terms, you may not participate in the Program.

1. AFFILIATE APPROVAL

All Affiliate applications are subject to review and approval by Ghost Ridge Supply Co.

We reserve the right to approve or reject any application at our discretion. Acceptance into the Program does not create an employment relationship, partnership, joint venture, agency relationship, or ownership interest in Ghost Ridge Supply Co.

Affiliates participate as independent contractors.

2. AFFILIATE COMMISSION

Unless otherwise agreed in writing, approved Affiliates will begin at a 2.5% commission rate on Qualifying Sales.

Ghost Ridge believes performance should be rewarded. Affiliates who consistently generate meaningful sales, produce quality content, represent the brand well, and contribute to the growth of the Ghost Ridge community may become eligible for increased commission rates of up to 5%.

Higher commission rates are not guaranteed and may be based on performance, sales volume, consistency, content quality, compliance, and the overall relationship between the Affiliate and Ghost Ridge.

Top-performing Affiliates may also become eligible for additional opportunities, including free Ghost Ridge merchandise or gear, early product access, special projects, featured content, events, and in-person collaborations.

Perform. Grow with us. Become part of the Ridge.

3. QUALIFYING SALES

A “Qualifying Sale” is a successfully completed and paid purchase attributed to an Affiliate through an approved Ghost Ridge affiliate link, tracking cookie, or assigned promotional code.

Unless otherwise stated, commissions are calculated using the eligible merchandise subtotal after applicable discounts.

Commissions are not paid on sales tax, shipping charges, refunded purchases, canceled orders, fraudulent transactions, chargebacks, or other amounts excluded by Ghost Ridge.

If an order is refunded, canceled, charged back, or determined to be fraudulent after commission has been credited, the corresponding commission may be canceled or deducted from future Affiliate earnings.

4. AFFILIATE LINKS & DISCOUNT CODES

Approved Affiliates may receive a personalized referral link and/or promotional discount code.

When provided, an Affiliate's promotional code may provide their audience with an exclusive Ghost Ridge customer discount, currently anticipated to be 5% on eligible purchases, subject to exclusions and future Program changes.

Affiliate links and codes are intended to help Ghost Ridge accurately identify the creators responsible for generating traffic and sales.

Affiliates may only promote codes officially assigned or approved by Ghost Ridge. Affiliates may not create, advertise, distribute, or represent unauthorized Ghost Ridge coupon codes or discounts.

A customer cannot generate multiple commissions for the same transaction.

5. COOKIE-BASED ATTRIBUTION

Ghost Ridge currently uses cookie-based tracking to attribute eligible referral activity.

When a prospective customer clicks an Affiliate's approved referral link, a tracking cookie may be placed on the customer's device for the attribution period displayed in the Affiliate dashboard or Program settings.

If the customer completes a Qualifying Sale during that attribution period, the applicable Affiliate may receive commission even if the customer does not click the Affiliate's link again before purchasing.

Where multiple Affiliate referrals occur, attribution will generally follow the tracking rules configured within the Ghost Ridge Affiliate Program platform, including applicable last-click or coupon attribution rules.

Customers must permit the technologies necessary for referral tracking. Ghost Ridge cannot guarantee attribution when customers block cookies, clear cookies, change devices or browsers, use tracking-prevention technologies, or otherwise prevent the Program from identifying the referral.

Ghost Ridge will not manually create commissions for transactions that cannot reasonably be verified through our tracking system.

6. PAYMENTS

Affiliates are responsible for providing accurate and current payment information through their Affiliate dashboard.

Commissions become payable according to the payment schedule and minimum payout requirements, if any, displayed within the Program.

Ghost Ridge reserves the right to review referral transactions before approving commission payments.

Only legitimate, successfully completed Qualifying Sales are eligible for payment.

Ghost Ridge may withhold or reverse commissions associated with suspected fraud, manipulation, returns, chargebacks, prohibited promotional practices, or violations of these Terms.

7. CREATOR FREEDOM & GHOST RIDGE BRAND STANDARDS

We chose to work with creators because we want creators—not corporate spokespeople.

Affiliates are encouraged to use their own personality, voice, humor, style, and creative approach when talking about Ghost Ridge.

We don't expect every Affiliate to sound the same.

However, creative freedom does not authorize false, deceptive, illegal, or misleading statements.

Affiliates may not falsely represent themselves as employees, owners, agents, or official spokespersons of Ghost Ridge Supply Co.

Affiliates may not make false claims about Ghost Ridge products, pricing, promotions, discounts, availability, sweepstakes, prizes, odds, or business practices.

Be yourself. Be authentic. Just don't make shit up.

8. SWEEPSTAKES & PROMOTIONAL CONTENT

Ghost Ridge may conduct promotional sweepstakes from time to time pursuant to applicable Official Rules.

Affiliates promoting a Ghost Ridge sweepstakes must use accurate information and comply with the Official Rules and any promotional guidance supplied by Ghost Ridge.

Affiliates may not independently create or modify sweepstakes rules, eligibility requirements, entry methods, deadlines, prize descriptions, prize values, odds, winner-selection procedures, or other material terms.

Affiliates may not state or imply that purchasing merchandise is required to enter or win when a free Alternative Method of Entry is available under the applicable Official Rules.

If an Affiliate is uncertain about a sweepstakes claim:

Ask Ghost Ridge before posting it.

The applicable Official Rules control in the event of any conflict between Affiliate content and the Official Rules.

9. DISCLOSURE REQUIREMENTS

Affiliates must clearly disclose their material relationship with Ghost Ridge whenever required by applicable advertising, endorsement, consumer-protection, or platform rules.

This includes circumstances in which an Affiliate receives commissions, free products, discounts, trips, experiences, or other benefits from Ghost Ridge.

Required disclosures must be clear, conspicuous, and reasonably understandable to the Affiliate's audience.

Ghost Ridge may provide additional disclosure guidance, but each Affiliate remains responsible for complying with applicable laws and platform requirements.

10. PROHIBITED CONDUCT

Ghost Ridge reserves the right to suspend or terminate Affiliates who engage in conduct including, but not limited to:

  • Fraudulent or manipulated transactions;

  • Unauthorized coupon distribution or coupon-site abuse;

  • False or misleading advertising;

  • Misrepresentation of Ghost Ridge or its products;

  • Misrepresentation of sweepstakes rules or prizes;

  • Spam or deceptive traffic-generation practices;

  • Unauthorized use of Ghost Ridge intellectual property;

  • Manipulation of Affiliate tracking or attribution;

  • Transactions intended primarily to generate improper commissions;

  • Illegal activity connected to promotion of Ghost Ridge;

  • Conduct that materially damages the Ghost Ridge brand or customer community; or

  • Material violations of these Terms.

Ghost Ridge reserves the right to investigate suspicious activity and withhold associated commissions while an investigation is pending.

11. MARKETING MATERIALS

Ghost Ridge may provide approved logos, photographs, videos, graphics, product images, banners, promotional materials, or other creative assets through the Affiliate dashboard or directly to Affiliates.

Affiliates may use approved materials for the purpose of promoting Ghost Ridge while participating in the Program.

Ghost Ridge retains ownership of its trademarks, logos, copyrighted materials, branding, and other intellectual property.

Participation in the Affiliate Program does not transfer ownership of Ghost Ridge intellectual property to the Affiliate.

12. FREE PRODUCTS, GEAR & COLLABORATIONS

Participation in the Affiliate Program does not guarantee free products, merchandise, travel, appearances, collaborations, or other benefits beyond earned commissions.

However, Ghost Ridge intends to invest in Affiliates who demonstrate exceptional performance and alignment with the brand.

Selected Affiliates may receive merchandise, gear, early-access opportunities, featured content, invitations to special projects or events, or opportunities to collaborate directly with Ghost Ridge.

These opportunities are offered at Ghost Ridge's discretion and may vary between Affiliates.

13. PROGRAM CHANGES

Ghost Ridge is building this Program for the long term, and the Program will evolve as the company grows.

We reserve the right to modify commission structures, performance tiers, customer discounts, cookie periods, attribution methods, payment schedules, promotional policies, eligibility requirements, and other Program terms.

Material changes will be communicated through reasonable means, including the Affiliate dashboard, email, or updated Program Terms.

Continued participation following the effective date of updated Terms constitutes acceptance of those Terms to the extent permitted by applicable law.

14. TERMINATION

Affiliates may leave the Program at any time by contacting Ghost Ridge or using available account-management features.

Ghost Ridge may suspend or terminate an Affiliate's participation for violations of these Terms, suspected fraud, unlawful activity, misuse of the Program, or other legitimate business reasons.

Valid commissions earned from legitimate Qualifying Sales before termination will generally remain payable, subject to refund periods, fraud review, chargebacks, these Terms, and applicable law.

Fraudulent or prohibited transactions are not eligible for commission.

15. INDEPENDENT RELATIONSHIP

Participation in the Ghost Ridge Affiliate Program does not make an Affiliate an employee of Ghost Ridge Supply Co.

Affiliates are independent participants responsible for their own content, business activities, taxes, licenses, disclosures, and compliance obligations.

Nothing in these Terms creates an employment relationship, franchise, partnership, agency, or joint venture between Ghost Ridge and an Affiliate.

16. CONTACT

Questions concerning the Ghost Ridge Affiliate Program may be directed to:

Ghost Ridge Supply Co.
Affiliate Support

GhostRidgeSupplyCo@Gmail.com


WELCOME TO THE RIDGE.

We're not interested in building another generic influencer program.

We're looking for creators who genuinely fit the culture, believe in what we're building, and want the opportunity to grow alongside Ghost Ridge.

Create great content. Bring value to your audience. Generate results. Get rewarded.

Let's see where this thing goes.
